title: [Android, WearOS] Digital Watch Face - DA138 A$0.30 (Was A$1.49) @ Google Play
body:
Deal: [Android, WearOS] Digital Watch Face - DA138 A$0.30 (Was A$1.49) @ Google Play

[PainToad] An impressive amount of info you've managed to fit on this watchface without it looking too cultured!
If only it was for Apple Watch.
[Adamwear] Unfortunately, apple watch has a fairly closed system, dials are not allowed to be upload. Individual watch faces can be selected within the WatchMaker application. Maybe I'll make an apple version of this within the watchmaker app.
[odlaner] I will try it - I love these watch faces, the only issue are my glasses getting stronger by the year
[Adamwear] I feel the same way about it, unfortunately.
[Adamwear] 4 customizable shortucts and 4 customizable app complications on the top
[Think] What are differences between shortucts and apps?
[Adamwear] The shortcuts are just small icons that open a specific app when you tap them (the small, round white icons in the image). The customizable app complications display specific data (at the top: the next event, step count, BPM, and sunrise).
[nedski] I bought this for my OnePlus watch 4. Works really well and love the short cuts.
[Adamwear] Thanks for your support. I have a "buy one, get one" promotion running, so if you send me your order number and choose another watch face, you'll get a free coupon.
